# manuscript: its id (the shelfmark in lower case, without spaces), shelfmark, catalogue number, date as
# catalogued, folios, hands, texts counted coarsely and finely, languages (ISO 639-3), whether it is homogeneous
# (1 yes, 0 no, ? undecided) and the number of colours besides plain ink. Then two facts from elsewhere: the
# material of its leaves, from the case study's metadata (whether parchment is included) checked against the National
# Library's record in Manuscriptorium (the physical description of its IIIF manifest), empty where they disagree; and
# its title, the label of that manifest, square brackets included (a title the cataloguer supplied).
